description.value: True Confections is a Vancouver institution that has been crafting cakes, cheesecakes, pies, and pastries entirely from scratch for over 35 years. Located on Denman Street in the West End, it sits at the threshold of Stanley Park — one of the most popular cycling corridors in the city — making it a natural stop for riders finishing a loop. The shop offers a wide dessert menu alongside Tartine's lunch items, catering, and multiple to-go formats.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (6 spaces) at 45m; stands (12 spaces, covered) at 53m; stands (4 spaces) at 75m. Total: 22 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms True Confections is an active, long-established business with Father's Day promotions live at time of fetch, and the about page states '35 years' of scratch dessert production. The website explicitly lists a 'Gluten Free & Vegan' cake category and 'Slices ToGo'/'High Tea To Go' menu sections, corroborating OSM's diet:vegetarian=yes and confirming takeout. No evidence for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities appears in either the website content or OSM tags; the contact page content was too truncated to confirm phone or address.
concerns: About page text truncates mid-sentence ('We produce all our desserts in house at both Downto...'), suggesting a possible second location — OSM record covers only the Denman Street address.
Contact and FAQ subpages were heavily truncated; phone number and address could not be independently verified from website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: True Confections is a well-established food business in a prime cycling location near Stanley Park and the Seawall, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from available evidence. On-site verification of these basics is needed before inclusion.
